## Definition of Done (CLAUDE.md)

- [ ] Tests cover the happy path and obvious failures; `make check` passes
- [ ] `llm-wiki/` page updated; ADRs true; `14-known-gaps.md` updated if a gap opened or closed
- [ ] `PLAN.md` status: section 0, wave row `**Done (#PR):**`, day row, requirement checkbox or `partial:` note
- [ ] Deployed and smoke-checked (if it touches deployed infrastructure)
